_comment: The tactical battle (wire id 65, open fix 52), work order 197 C. Everything is placed from the battle's own state (open fixes 53-57) and drawn in the original's pictures out of the player's LBX files (tools/combat_art_extract.py); this file carries no geometry, only the markings — one per thing HD does that the original does not, or leaves out. The brief is dev:doc/combat_screen_brief.md, the reading dev:doc/combat_drawing_reading.md.

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED until work order 197's live acceptance is recorded.
marks.hd_extension_free_camera: HD EXTENSION — the field is zoomed by the wheel about the pointer and panned by a right drag, as the galaxy map; the original scrolls its 32 x 18 window by the pointer at the screen's edges (combinit.cpp:2387-2496). The camera starts at the original's framing, 32 cells across round the acting unit.
marks.hd_extension_hd_painted: HD EXTENSION — a painted battle picture in the mod folder may be its stored drawing’s size or a whole k times it; it is drawn at the drawing’s size and place, shrunk smoothly, so its detail shows as the camera zooms in; another size is refused for the game’s drawing. The original draws its 640 x 480 drawings and nothing finer (decision 81, Data, work order 214; cbart._painted, cbdraw.scaled).
marks.hd_extension_whole_grid: HD EXTENSION — the whole 81 x 68 field can be on the screen at once; the original shows 32 x 18 cells; both draw the reduced map in the panel (work order 209 B1, cbmap).
marks.deviation_hud_panel: DEVIATION — the acting unit's panel (name, systems, the picture with its shields, weapons or special systems, buttons) is HUD blocks in OrionLayer's words along the bottom, not COMBAT.LBX 0 with its pictures and labels.
marks.deviation_glass_alpha: DEVIATION — a picture's glass pixels (0xF0-0xFF) are drawn at half alpha; the original blends them through a table per effect (animate.cpp:279-287, combinit.cpp:855-989).
marks.deviation_star_parallax: DEVIATION — the star layers move at 1, 1/2 and 1/8 of the camera; the original's two scroll paths disagree with each other (combinit.cpp:2266-2276, 2458-2482).
marks.deviation_ordnance_stack: DEVIATION — a stack of missiles or fighters is one picture with its count; the original lays up to nine pictures out in its stack patterns (cmbtmis.cpp:735-873).
marks.deviation_untimed_pace: DEVIATION — a loop the original does not time (a missile's or fighter group's flight, a launch flight, the gyro's spin, the plasma web's travel, a teleport, a move's step) runs at a fixed 15 ms a pass by elapsed time, at every frame rate; the original draws one such pass per presented frame, 1.9 ms measured (work order 213), so it has no tempo of its own to match (decision 80, Data, work order 214; cbplay.UNTIMED_S).
marks.transcription_beam_bolt: TRANSCRIPTION — a beam is the original's bolt (bolt.cpp; beams.cpp:2233-2636): the weapon's sixteen colours (Set_Beam_Colors_, :2481-2564, from the table at :1848-2062), its style (thin, wide, continuous, three-layer), the head advancing its step a frame for _max_frames frames, stopped at a third of the shield when it holds, the muzzle burst (BEAMS 1-64) and the hit flash (BEAMS 65/66). Retires work order 197's beam_simplified.
marks.deviation_beam_fire_point: DEVIATION — a beam leaves the shooter's centre; the original starts it at one of the picture's fire points (FIREPTS, not on the wire). The mauler, the breaths, the spatial compressor and weapon 46 are drawn as the same thin bolt in their BEAMS.LBX 0 fragment's colours, not their own renderer.
marks.deviation_event_marks: DEVIATION — a capture, a raid and a special without its own frames here (the anti-missile rocket) are shown as their word over the unit for a moment; the original plays each its own effect.
marks.transcription_pace: TRANSCRIPTION — the events are played at the original's pace: a move 10 frames a cell (HD 0.15 s), a turn one facing per 55 ms frame, an effect one frame per 55 ms (Release_Time_(1)), damage numbers 9 frames rising 1 px a frame (beams.cpp:230-435).
marks.transcription_board_popup: TRANSCRIPTION — the board popup (wire id 67, open fix 66's CPOP): the game's message, the range and the marines chosen as the engine holds them (CMBTDRW1::_g_min/_g_max/_g_var), the two arrows, RAID and CAPTURE as the original's own button fields, ESC as its hotkey (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1581-1666, 2744-2763); an arrow only after the last one's effect arrived, down while the choice is above 0 and up while below the top (:1638-1644).
marks.transcription_scan_contents: TRANSCRIPTION — the scan view shows one unit's combat bonuses, crew, marines, drive, computer, structure, armour, shields, speed and weapons, and any click closes it (Detailed_View_Ship_, Combat_Draw_View_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:156-247, 3114-).
marks.deviation_scan_view: DEVIATION — the scan view is a HUD popup in OrionLayer's words over the dimmed battle, not COMBAT.LBX 5 with the unit's large picture and the game's words.
marks.hd_extension_scan_local: HD EXTENSION — HD's SCAN opens its view of the clicked unit without telling the engine: the original's scan changes nothing in the game (it reads a copy, cmbtdrw1.cpp:1550). When the engine itself is in its scan view (under F12), HD draws the unit CPOP names and a click closes it through the view's own exit field.
marks.transcription_special_effects: TRANSCRIPTION — the stasis field, tractor beam, gyro destabilizer, plasma web, black hole, stellar converter, a bomb's flight and impact, a blast round its source and the web on a unit are the original's own frames at their places and pace (cmbtspec.cpp, cmbtfire.cpp:963-1002, cmbtdrw1.cpp:3012-3096).
marks.deviation_texture_line: DEVIATION — a picture drawn along a line (Draw_Bitmap_Line_, bitmap.cpp:298-336: stretched to the line, turned to its angle) is turned by pygame's rotation; the original's own resampling is not traced.
marks.transcription_weapon_rows: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row as Draw_Weapon_Status_Display_ writes it (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2765-2933): the shots left, the Hv / Pd prefix, the name for one shot and the plural otherwise, x<ammo> for missiles, bombs, fighters and the anti-missile rocket, <n>t for a recharging torpedo, the arc word in brackets for a beam; the special systems list from the unit's own flags (:543-591); the colours: transcription_row_colours.
marks.deviation_shield_rings: DEVIATION — the shields round the unit's picture in the panel are HD's rings, one per ten points left in each of the four arcs, not COMBAT.LBX's ring masks (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2057-2344).
marks.transcription_row_colours: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row's count and words in the colour Draw_Weapon_Status_Display_ picks (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2765-2846), battle palette: switched on green 0x53, on and able to hit the unit or missile under the pointer bright green 0x56, switched off for one shot or unable to fire (no ammunition, a torpedo recharging, no shots left) yellow 0xDC, switched off red 0x4A; a unit the computer controls all green; the specials red when damaged, green while ready, else yellow (:543-589). Data's decision 2 of work order 209 replaced work order 203's blue bars.
marks.transcription_row_columns: TRANSCRIPTION — the weapon row's count right-aligned at x 127 and its name from x 131 of the original's 114..263 list (Print_Integer_Right_ and Print_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2858, :2929), as fractions of the row's width, so the count stands clear of the row's frame (work order 210 B4).
marks.transcription_teleport: TRANSCRIPTION — a teleport move dissolves the unit out of its cell and into the new one in the same ten frames (five FAST) through Vanish_Bitmap_ and _noise_table (cmbtmov1.cpp:816-886, shear.cpp:24-42, 540-588); HD gives a frame 15 ms where the original’s loop has no wait (DEVIATION untimed_pace, decision 80) (cbcloak, work order 210 C4).
marks.transcription_lightning: TRANSCRIPTION — the Lightning Field: CMBTSFX 0 at the unit’s centre less 36 for 15 ticks, its frames running on from the last field’s (Lightning_Field_, cmbtspec.cpp:216-271), before each missile hit or fighter pass at a unit with a working field (cmbtmis.cpp:312-333); no event names it, HD infers it (HD STATE lightning_inferred, proposed open fix 76) (cbplay, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_spherical_sfx: TRANSCRIPTION — Do_Spherical_SFX_ (cmbtspec.cpp:1589-1840) drawn on the event that fires it, every time: Plasma Flux and Pulsar CMBTSFX 0x34, the Spatial Compressor CMBTSFX 6, the source over it; a ship dying in a blast SPHERSFX 0 / 1 with the ship collapsing under it; units in reach shaken by distance and ring (cbblast, work order 210 C3, C4).
marks.deviation_shake_random: DEVIATION — a shaken unit is drawn -2..+2 px off its place; the original takes the numbers from the game’s Random_(5), HD from its own (cbblast, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_death_picture: TRANSCRIPTION — a plain death: CMBTSFX 3 / 4 / 5 by size, frames 0..n-1 a tick each, its top-left at the centre less (12, 9) / (23, 20) / (47, 44), the unit gone from frame n / 2 (cmbtspec.cpp:1192-1276) (cbblast, work order 210 C4).
marks.transcription_anti_missile: TRANSCRIPTION — the anti-missile rocket: a 3 x 3 dot in palette 25, corners 16, 20 px a tick (30 FAST) from the source’s centre to the missile, then CMBTSFX 7 at the missile less 12 when it destroyed any (cmbtspec.cpp:686-797, 1395-1408); HD reads the count from the next state (HD STATE anti_missile_count, proposed open fix 75) (cbsfx, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_cloak: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit with special_status_flag 1 or 5 drawn through Plasma_Darken_ (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2627-2630, 2935-3006): each pixel remapped through Create_Ship_Darken_Map_ (:2671-2742) by the plasma map COMBAT.LBX 0x31 at (_ship_frame + unit * 2) % 16, darkness 6; for every viewer (cbcloak, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_phasing: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit with special_status_flag 4 drawn as its outline in palette index 5 while the acting unit is the local player’s, and not at all otherwise (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2617-2625; Outline_Bitmap_, shear.cpp:131-213) (cbcloak, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_cloak_fades: TRANSCRIPTION — Draw_Cloak_’s fades: cloaking 24 steps, uncloaking 24, phasing 60, unphasing 36, a step a tick (two under FAST), each its own darkness rule (cmbtspec.cpp:59-121); HD plays one when the state it adopts changes a unit’s flag (HD STATE cloak_fade_time; cbcloak.Fades, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_lasting_overlay: TRANSCRIPTION — what stays on a held unit after its picture, one of three: the stasis ball at 100 %, else the plasma web at _ship_frame % frames, else the black hole at (_ship_frame / 2) % 8 (+ 8 past its first turn) (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2641-2653) (cbdraw.lasting_overlay, work order 210 C2).
marks.transcription_lasting_tractor: TRANSCRIPTION — a tractor that holds (special_cooldown names a live unit) drawn as CMBTSFX 2 frame 6 between the centres, under the units (Draw_Continuing_Tractor_, cmbtspec.cpp:140-173; cmbtdrw1.cpp:506-515) (cbdraw.draw_tractors, work order 210 C2).
marks.transcription_reduced_map: TRANSCRIPTION — the reduced map at the panel's right end as Draw_Reduced_Combat_Map_ and Draw_Reduced_Map_Box_ draw it (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1168-1262): the whole field at 3/2 px a cell, the planet, a blip per live unit in its side's ramp, a dot per missile, brackets round the view; a click centres the view there (combat1.cpp:685-686). Work order 209 B1, Data's decision 1.
marks.omission_missile_warning_picture: OMISSION — with MISSILE WARNING on and a missile on its way to a human player's unit the original shows its warning picture in the reduced map's place (cmbtdrw1.cpp:874-878, 1849-1857); the warning is not on the wire, so HD keeps the map.
marks.transcription_tab_words: TRANSCRIPTION — the WEAPONS / SPECIALS words are drawn at the size of the buttons' words: the original's pictures (COMBAT.LBX 7 and 8) carry them at the same 7-row cap height as AUTO ... DONE (COMBAT.LBX 0x32-0x36), in a tab twice the word's cap tall as the picture is (combinit.cpp:688, 697; cmbtdrw1.cpp:1268-1273).
marks.transcription_shield_flare: TRANSCRIPTION — a beam that strikes a shield makes it flare as the original's shot loop does (beams.cpp:437-478, 557-704, 2466-2470): while the bolt's head is inside the shield's square the flare ramps in, loops and plays out; BEAMS 67-86 by size and the hit's rotation folded to five drawings and a flip (109- when pierced, 129- for an enveloping weapon, 133-152 round a planet), the target's picture brightened 30 + 4 j per cent under the flare's glass pixel 0xF0 + j and snapped to the battle palette, the flare drawn over it. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_combat_options: TRANSCRIPTION — the OPTIONS button under the battle's buttons and its panel (combat1.cpp:111-178, cmbtdrw1.cpp:1268-1322, 1463-1544): while open fix 68's COPT says the panel is up, its title (the same button, ESC), SELF DESTRUCT and the five lights MISSILE WARNING, FAST ANIMATIONS, SHOW LEGAL MOVES, SHOW SHIELD ARCS, DISPLAY GRID as the battle holds them, each click the original's own field. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_option_drawing: TRANSCRIPTION — what the options draw: the grid, a line every 20 px in colour 4 (cmbtdrw1.cpp:528-535); the acting unit's shield arcs, four borders in colour 0x54 and the letters F R B L (A D I S in the Italian game only) in colour 0x81 (Draw_Shield_Arcs_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:21-152); the legal cells from the battle's own flag; FAST ANIMATIONS as the original's steps under _speedx2_flag (a move 12 px a frame, a bolt two frames, the specials every second frame, a retreat every third).
marks.transcription_board_slider: TRANSCRIPTION — the board popup's bar is the original's scroll field (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1602) and dragging it sets the choice as Find_Bar_Position_ does (fields.cpp:1720-1762): the place along the field's 207 px times the range over the width, plus the minimum, held to the range; on release HD clicks the field at the place that gives the shown choice (open fix 3 keeps the injected pointer) and then shows the wire's choice. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_release_stasis: TRANSCRIPTION — a click on an enemy held in a stasis field asks to release it (KENTEXT 61, the game’s box in HD’s) and releases it on YES, as the original’s click does (combat1.cpp:782-796, Ship_Is_In_Stasis_ cmbtmov1.cpp:53-58); HD sends open fix 58’s REMOVE_STASIS, the engine refusing a FIRE there (work order 214, cbinput).
marks.transcription_weapon_switch: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row is the original's own switch: its hidden field (combat1.cpp:180-183) cycles the slot's active 1 -> 0 -> -1 -> 1 (:594-613); HD clicks it, the next once the change is on the wire, shows the row lit at 1, dimmed at 0, dark at -1 (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2786-2849), and FIRE sends the rows at 1. Only -1 keeps a weapon out of the defensive fire (cmbtfir2.cpp:868-930).
marks.transcription_energy_absorber: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit whose Energy Absorber holds a charge (reflected_damage_pool) glows behind its picture: CMBTSFX 0x33 + (-1 - size) / 2 (one less for size 4) at (ship_frame / 2 + unit) modulo its frames, centred on the unit, not in stasis or under a plasma web (Draw_Energy_Absorber_, cmbtfire.cpp:923-953; Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2632-2637).
marks.transcription_combat_help: TRANSCRIPTION — a right click on the battle's panel opens the help Set_Combat_Help_Fields_ gives there (combat1.cpp:2402-2590): the buttons 623-628 and OPTIONS 617, or with the OPTIONS panel up SELF DESTRUCT 695 and the lights 696-700; the current ship display 618 (HD's picture) and the systems display 622 (HD's lines of the unit's systems); a weapon row its tech application's entry (a special system's on the specials tab), an empty row the weapons display 629. The reduced map (620/621) has no HD element. screens/combat/cbhelp.py, work order 200.
marks.transcription_reflection: TRANSCRIPTION — a reflection plays as the original's shot loop does (beams.cpp:1480-1530, 1724-1837, 2388-2424; cmbtfire.cpp:1743-1748): the shooter's weapon fired back from the reflector, its tail a third of the reflection field's diameter (29, 52, 71, 86) out, past every shield; the reflection field's flare on the reflector, BEAMS.LBX 0x59 + size * 5 + rotation from the shooter, on at once, four frames in, then out; the reflected damage over the shooter.
marks.transcription_firing: TRANSCRIPTION — one FIRE is one loop: its shots grouped by weapon slot, two entries drawn at a time, the second starting at frame 9, each frame 55 ms, ended when both are done, the flare is off and the numbers have risen (Beam_SFX_, beams.cpp:1312-1712; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_effect_pace: TRANSCRIPTION — every effect at the source's pace: each loop's Release_Time_(n) per frame, the damage numbers held until done (cmbtspec.cpp:1013, :1549; beams.cpp:495-508; work order 212, cbplay.sfx_times); HD STATE view_pause: no 7-tick pause before a ship off the original's view explodes (cmbtspec.cpp:1175-1178), HD's camera is not that view
marks.transcription_gyro_line: TRANSCRIPTION — the gyro destabilizer's line loops its last three frames while the target turns, eight passes of 2 ticks (cmbtspec.cpp:1511-1549; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_web_travel: TRANSCRIPTION — the plasma web's blob travels 6 px a frame from the source to the target, then its impact (Plasma_Web_, cmbtspec.cpp:1060-1140; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_sound_player: TRANSCRIPTION — the battle's sounds are the game's own SOUND.LBX, played by HD at the point of its animation the engine names (open fix 79), at the Sound Fx level, faded 10 a tick, looped and pitched as sound.cpp does (work order 212, cbsound)
marks.transcription_flight: TRANSCRIPTION — missiles, torpedoes and fighters fly their path, speed px a pass, turned toward their target, before the hits resolve (Seeking_Missiles_, combat1.cpp:2158-2249; Move_Missile_, cmbtmis.cpp:132-216; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_fighter_beams: TRANSCRIPTION — a fighter pass fires its owner's point-defence beam from a quarter of the group, from the stack's places, then its number rises (Fighter_Combat_SFX_, cmbtmis.cpp:875-970; open fix 77; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_multi_beam: TRANSCRIPTION — the Mass Driver and the Gauss Cannon fire three bolts a frame apart with the second muzzle set, the Mauler Device and the breaths three bolts; the last bolt drawn decides the hit and the flare (beams.cpp:856-909, 1155-1179, 1243-1266; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_mauler_ball: TRANSCRIPTION — the mauler ball BEAMS.LBX 0x58 at a bolt's head until it strikes (beams.cpp:2420-2422; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_transporter_beam: TRANSCRIPTION — with Transporters a bomb starts near the planet after 8 ticks of CMBTSFX 15 along the line in the stasis bubble's glass (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3024-3040, cmbtspec.cpp:800-854; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_missile_frames: TRANSCRIPTION — a missile cycles its first three frames, (_ship_frame + index) % 3, while it is aimed at the acting unit, the Proton Torpedo always; a fighter group while its final target is the acting unit; otherwise frame 0 (Draw_Missile_, cmbtmis.cpp:1130-1136; Draw_Fighter_, :1107-1111; work order 214, cbdraw.ordnance_frame).
marks.transcription_launch_flight: TRANSCRIPTION — a missile leaves its ship flying 12 px a pass to where its launch puts it, the Proton Torpedo and the Dragon Breath the whole way to their target (Missile_Launch_FX_, cmbtspec.cpp:856-948; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_gyro_spin: TRANSCRIPTION — the gyro destabilizer spins its target as many sixteenths of a turn as the engine drew (19 of Random_(13), then more while it would end 15, 0 or 1 round, cmbtspec.cpp:566-575), on the wire since open fix 83; an engine without it leaves HD STATE gyro_spin, two turns round (work order 213, Data's decision 2)
marks.transcription_specials_list: TRANSCRIPTION — the SPECIALS tab lists the special bits below SPECIAL_REGENERATION, as _amoeba_regeneration is never set (cmbtdrw1.cpp:557-558, combinit.h:11), row after row 11 px apart with no cap (:559-582) (work order 213)
marks.transcription_monster_file: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit built by no player, the Antarans (player 8) as much as a monster (10 and up), is drawn from MONSTER.LBX[picture_num] (picture 44: entry 25); CMBTSHP[colour * 45 + picture_num] only for previous_owner < MAX_PLAYERS (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2535-2545; work order 215, cbdraw.from_monster_file).
marks.transcription_monster_glow: TRANSCRIPTION — a monster's picture (previous_owner > 9) runs its four frames in turn, (_ship_frame / 2) % 4, frame 0 included; a player's or an Antaran's the cycle {1, 2, 3, 2} phased by the unit (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2499-2508; work order 215, cbdraw.glow_frame).
marks.hd_extension_plating_colour: HD EXTENSION — a painted battle picture under the colour-free name cmbtshp/all_<picture>_<frame>.png serves every owner without a file of its own: its neutral grey (chroma below 0.05, to 0.10 in part, near-white kept) takes the owner's colour by the color blend, keeping light and shade; its colours stay as painted; a missing glow frame is the facing's frame 0, a missing stored facing is turned in code from the nearest given one at 2 x or more, the other eleven mirror and flip the five as the original's. The original draws eight different ships, one per colour (decision 82, Data, work order 216 P1; built by 217, cbpaint).
